'''Con Aybara''' was [[Perrin Aybara]]'s father and was married to [[Joslyn Aybara]].

==Appearance==
He was slim.

==History==
He had one other son named [[Paetram]], often called Little Paet, and two daughters named [[Adora]] and [[Deselle]].

==Activities==
[[Padan Fain]] murders Perrin's entire family including Con because Con and Joslyn laughed at him and insulted him when Fain told them Perrin was a [[Darkfriend]].
